- Initial release of dingtalk-bot: DingTalk Bot integration for messaging, group management, approval workflows, and attendance.
- Supports sending messages (text, markdown, link, and action card) via webhook and API.

- Enables creation and tracking of approval workflows.
- Provides attendance record queries and vacation balance checks.
